purpose: Complete machine-readable pin of the native Surge XT oracle: engine source, submodules, build toolchain, audio runtime, and harness semantics. The executable sound reference lives OUTSIDE this repository (GPL-3.0-or-later); this repository (Apache-2.0) stores only pins, scripts, and evidence.

engine.license: GPL-3.0-or-later (kept external; no engine source, assets, or binaries are copied into this repository)

expected_checkout.rule: any drift of engine HEAD, submodule SHA, or modified tracked files aborts fetch-and-build.sh

build.python_binding_note: surgepy evidence runtime is homebrew python3.11 (numpy 1.26.4 present). python3.12/3.13 were rejected for lack of a numpy runtime. A full surgepy module build against python3.14 from the same pinned tree (build dir build-py314) also succeeded and imports with identical engine version and 48 kHz; the pinned pybind11 (2.11.0-172-g7c33cdc2) is therefore not the limiting factor here. 3.11 was kept as the pinned evidence runtime for numpy availability and single-runtime consistency, not because 3.14 failed. PYBIND11_FINDPYTHON=OFF forces pybind11's classic FindPythonLibsNew, which strictly honors PYTHON_EXECUTABLE; the default new-style FindPython in this environment resolves a broken anaconda interpreter (/opt/homebrew/anaconda3, missing include dir) regardless of Python_ROOT_DIR/Python_EXECUTABLE hints (transcript: reports/sxt-010/findpython-interpreter-resolution.txt).

runtime.block_size_note: SURGE_COMPILE_BLOCK_SIZE default 32 (src/CMakeLists.txt); process scheduling is per-multiblock via surgepy.processMultiBlock
runtime.data_home_note: Engine env override read by SurgeStorage::getOverrideDataHome (src/common/SurgeStorage.cpp); pins all factory assets/wavetables to the pinned source tree, never to machine-global Surge installs
runtime.reset_policy: Harness calls allNotesOff() before each patch load; loadPatch() unstreams the patch into a fresh patch object. No global engine state outside the loaded patch is modified by the harness.
runtime.tuning: Engine default: standard 12-TET, no SCL/KBM override, default tuningApplicationMode. MTS-ESP client not connected.
runtime.randomness: No seed override is applied; the pinned engine's own RNG initialization is part of the reference. The first-note capture measures render-to-render repeatability and reports it (bit-identical or max abs diff), it does not assume determinism.

generators.FXModControl::rng: sst-basic-blocks dsp::RNG (std::minstd_rand), ONE PER FXModControl INSTANCE, seeded from std::chrono::system_clock at construction; drives mod_wave 5 (Noise) and 6 (Sample & Hold). Consumers at the pin: sst-effects Phaser, Surge Neuron (via Surge::ModControl).
generators.SurgeStorage::rngGen: std::minstd_rand, ONE PER SurgeStorage (shared by every storage->rand_* consumer on the audio thread), seeded from std::chrono::system_clock at construction; reached from FX through SurgeSSTFXAdapter.h rand01 -> EffectCore storageRand01(). Consumers at the pin: sst-effects Flanger (waves 3/4), Surge Combulator (noise mix > 0).
generators.chowdsp std::random_device: per-processor generators in Tape and Spring Reverb; strictly less pinnable than the clock-seeded generators.

fx_modulation_randomness.finding: No reseed call site reachable from a patch load exists in the pinned engine (SurgeStorage::seed_rand is commented out), so the seed is a function of wall-clock time and not of the patch or of this manifest. Two loads of the same patch therefore do not share an FX-modulation RNG stream. Pinning one would require PATCHING the pinned engine, and this manifest states that the pinned engine's own RNG initialization IS part of the reference -- a patched engine is a different reference.
fx_modulation_randomness.consequence: Model and RTL leaves REFUSE the RNG-driven FX modulation shapes fail-closed rather than substituting a convenient deterministic shape; the preset-coverage cost is published as a reduction (reports/SXT-028-rng/artifacts/coverage-impact.json) and routed to SXT-017 (#12). This manifest field records the characterization; it does not change any pin and applies no seed override.

environment.python_alternatives_verified: 3.14.7: full surgepy build + import verified (build-py314), not used for evidence; 3.12/3.13: no numpy runtime installed

licensing_note: Harness scripts in oracle/ are original to this repository (Apache-2.0, 2AMLogic convention). They import the external GPL engine at runtime and copy no Surge source, tables, assets, or presets into this repository. The WAV in reports/sxt-010/first-capture/ is this project's own render of a loaded preset, kept small (~2 s mono 16-bit), and is not a redistribution of upstream assets.
